fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 does not freeze the asymmetric higher-Lawrence matrix, control, targets, or adverse/legal states. G5 already supplies bounded overlap-kernel moves, and no argument prevents their diagonal or signed embedding in the lift; Graver growth alone also does not lower-bound every unrestricted CVP vector.

Proposal 2's Gram/center enumeration is unbounded without normalization and coefficient limits. Local Delaunay emptiness does not survive overlap, DROP, or signed splicing automatically, and the proposed finite search cannot test K11 scaling.

Proposal 3 is defeated structurally by K6: extending every honest encoding with zero fibers also extends any coefficient-sum-one affine combination of honest encodings with zero fibers. Hyperbolic transport therefore cannot charge the known G13/G15 collision unless a specified nonlinear emitted feature first separates it.

Proposal 4 supplies no exact target, common-radius certificate, or concatenation rule. Enumerating A2 glue codes only through k=4 can test finite coset placement but cannot discriminate the claimed adverse-versus-legal growth, while short honest-class representatives remain a K6/K8 threat.

Proposal 5 uses linear group-algebra/Fourier coordinates and table-flow linearizations, reopening K6 and the G19 signed-splicing attack. Fixed A5 has constant representation dimensions, and an unspecified 'first signed shell' is not an exhaustive CVP certificate or scaling mechanism.

Proposal 7 is a regression tool rather than a reduction candidate. Reconstructing already-known witnesses on G7/G15/G19/G32 cannot discriminate its proposed theorem, and successful reconstruction supplies no escape from any obstruction.

Proposal 6 is not valid as written: alternating numerical SDP and CVP calls cannot certify a global optimum at most one, and the metric cone, normalization, eigenvalue bounds, composition rule, and finite attack shell are not frozen. It is selectable only after replacing that procedure by the exact bounded experiment below; any positive result remains finite evidence, not K11 resolution.
evidence: No new verifier, emitted basis, target, control minimum, or shell certificate accompanies these proposals; all expected moves are presently unsupported.

G13 verified an exact harmful affine combination annihilating every compatible linear syndrome, and G15 lifted it through every hierarchy level with zero residual. This directly blocks zero-fiber transports and other linear extensions absent a proved escape.

G5 found short overlap kernels in every tested private-row composition, while G19 found an exact signed accepting splice. These are direct threats to the Lawrence, Delaunay-gluing, and multiplication-table mechanisms.

G28 measured adverse growth below legal growth, and G32 exhibited exactly additive zero-residual parity across two coupled copies. Consequently only an exact two-level optimization, not local separation, addresses the current K8 blocker.

G31 passed one finite equal-radius shell but supplied no growth law; G33/G34 then showed exact common-sphere and positive-metric failures in another geometric family. Proposal 6 is the only submission that makes both common-radius feasibility and unrestricted two-level growth explicit test conditions.
